# Rainbow progress bar (hand-drawn ink style)

| File | Size | Use |
|---|---|---|
| rainbow_bar_track.png / @2x | 288x24 / 576x48 | Background track (4px / 8px transparent padding around the 280x16 inner bar) |
| rainbow_bar_fill.png / @2x | 280x16 / 560x32 | Full-length 7-color rainbow fill (红橙黄绿青蓝紫), hatching + highlight, rounded ends |
| rainbow_bar_knob.png / @2x | 18x18 / 36x36 | Optional end knob |
| rainbow_bar_deco_star.png / @2x | 24x24 / 48x48 | Optional rainbow star sparkle |
| rainbow_bar_long_track.png | 600x32 | Long version (loading screens), 4px padding, inner 592x24 |
| rainbow_bar_long_fill.png | 592x24 | Long rainbow fill |

## Cocos Creator setup (3.x; same idea in 2.x)
1. Node `RainbowBar`: add **Sprite** = rainbow_bar_track (size 288x24 or 576x48). Add **ProgressBar** component.
2. Child node `Fill`: **Sprite** = rainbow_bar_fill, size 280x16 (or 560x32), anchor (0,0.5), position x = -140 (left edge of inner bar; -280 for @2x), y = 0.
3. Fill Sprite: **Type = FILLED**, **Fill Type = HORIZONTAL**, **Fill Start = 0**, Fill Range = progress.
4. ProgressBar: **Bar Sprite = Fill**, **Mode = FILLED**, Total Length = 1, set `progress` 0..1 in code: `bar.progress = 0.6;`
   (FILLED reveals the fixed rainbow left->right; red always at the start, purple only at 100%.)
5. Optional knob: child node, set `knob.x = -140 + 280 * progress` each update.
- Do NOT use BAR/HORIZONTAL mode with a stretched/9-sliced fill: it would squash the rainbow. No 9-slice fill is provided on purpose.
- Track can be 9-sliced to other widths: Sprite Type SLICED, border **L=12, R=12, T=0, B=0** (@2x: L=R=24; long: L=R=16).
- Filled sprites cut with a flat edge at the progress point; the knob (or star) hides it.
